children: The Marygold Companies entered into a definitive agreement with Madison Dearborn Partners for an all-cash take-private transaction. Marygold is the sole shareholder of USCF Investments, the parent of United States Commodity Funds, general partner of United States Brent Oil Fund. Closing is expected in the first half of 2027, subject to shareholder, regulatory, and change-of-control approvals, after which Marygold’s stock would be delisted from the NYSE. The parties indicated plans to refocus USCF’s business post-close, though completion is not guaranteed.
: Take TMC private and refocus USCF business
